public.aip_reconcile_budget_as_actor_a0v.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aip_reconcile_budget_as_actor_a0v_127(p_org text, p_project text, p_proposal text, p_decision text, p_actor text, p_hash text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('transaction_read_only')<>'on' OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUDGET_RECONCILE_READ_ONLY_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN public.aip_budget_consumption_fact_a0v_128(p_org,p_project,p_proposal,p_decision,p_actor,p_hash);
END $function$

public.aip_budget_cost_actor_a0v_127(tex.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aip_budget_cost_actor_a0v_127(p_org text, p_project text, p_proposal text, p_actor text, p_hash text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE p public.aip_budget_cost_proposal%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    IF session_user<>'aos_budget_consumer_call' OR current_user<>'aos_budget_consumer_owner'
       OR p_org IS DISTINCT FROM 'org-org' OR p_project IS DISTINCT FROM 'dev-project'
       OR current_setting('aos.org_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM p_org
       OR current_setting('aos.project_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM p_project
       OR p_actor IS NULL OR p_actor='' OR p_actor<>btrim(p_actor)
       OR p_hash IS NULL OR p_hash !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUDGET_CONSUMER_ACTOR_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN(session_user,current_user)
        AND (rolsuper OR rolinherit OR rolcreatedb OR rolcreaterole OR rolreplication OR rolbypassrls
          OR (rolname=current_user AND rolcanlogin)))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_auth_members WHERE roleid IN(session_user::regrole,current_user::regrole)
          OR member IN(session_user::regrole,current_user::regrole)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUDGET_CONSUMER_ROLE_DRIFT' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
    SELECT * INTO p FROM public.aip_budget_cost_proposal
        WHERE org_id=p_org AND project_id=p_project AND proposal_id=p_proposal;
    IF NOT FOUND OR p.maker_subject IS DISTINCT FROM p_actor OR p.proposal_hash IS DISTINCT FROM p_hash
       OR p.status<>'proposed' OR p.source_verification<>'pending' OR p.activation_eligible
       OR public.aip_budget_cost_hash_a0v_126(jsonb_build_object('domain','aos.budget-cost-proposal/v1','proposal',p.payload)) IS DISTINCT FROM p_hash
       OR p.payload->'tenant' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('orgId',p_org,'projectId',p_project)
       OR p.payload->>'makerSubject' IS DISTINCT FROM p_actor
       OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.meta_membership WHERE org_id=p_org AND project_id=p_project
           AND subject=p_actor AND lower(role) IN('owner','admin')) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUDGET_CONSUMER_ACTOR_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
    RETURN p.payload;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aip_budget_cost_hash_a0v_126(value jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'

aip_budget_active_insert_guard().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aip_budget_active_insert_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ BEGIN
      IF NEW.lifecycle='active' AND (session_user<>'aos_budget_consumer_call' OR current_user<>'aos_budget_consumer_owner') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUDGET_ACTIVATION_CONSUMPTION_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      RETURN NEW; END $function$

aip_budget_cost_fence_guard_a0v_126().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aip_budget_cost_fence_guard_a0v_126()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ BEGIN
      IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
        IF session_user<>'aos_budget_consumer_call' OR current_user<>'aos_budget_consumer_owner' OR NEW.version<>1 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUDGET_COST_FENCE_CONSUMER_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
      ELSIF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
        IF (NEW.org_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.budget_id,NEW.revision,NEW.decision_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
           (OLD.org_id,OLD.project_id,OLD.budget_id,OLD.revision,OLD.decision_id) OR NEW.version<>OLD.version+1 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUDGET_COST_FENCE_DRIFT' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUDGET_COST_FENCE_HISTORY_REQUIRED'; END IF;
      RETURN NEW; END $function$

aip_budget_cost_issuer_guard_a0v_125().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aip_budget_cost_issuer_guard_a0v_125()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ BEGIN
      IF session_user<>'aos_budget_cost_issuer' OR current_user<>'aos_runtime'
         OR current_setting('aos.org_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.org_id
         OR current_setting('aos.project_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.project_id
         OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user AND
           (NOT rolcanlogin OR rolinherit OR rolsuper OR rolcreatedb OR rolcreaterole OR rolreplication OR rolbypassrls))
         OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_auth_members WHERE roleid=session_user::regrole
           OR (member=session_user::regrole AND (roleid<>'aos_runtime'::regrole OR admin_option))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUDGET_COST_ISSUER_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
      END IF;
      IF TG_TABLE_NAME='aip_budget_cost_decision' THEN
        IF NEW.expires_at<=clock_timestamp() OR NOT EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM public.aip_budget_cost_proposal p WHERE p.org_id=NEW.org_id
            AND p.project_id=NEW.project_id AND p.proposal_id=NEW.proposal_id
            AND p.proposal_hash=NEW.proposal_hash AND p.checker_subject=NEW.actor_subject
            AND p.expires_at=NEW.expires_at) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUDGET_COST_EXACT_CURRENT_PROPOSAL_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
        END IF;
      END IF;
      RETURN NEW; END $function$

aip_budget_cost_receipt_guard_a0v_126().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aip_budget_cost_receipt_guard_a0v_126()

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ BEGIN
      IF NEW.operation='budget_revision.activate_cost' AND (session_user<>'aos_budget_consumer_call' OR current_user<>'aos_budget_consumer_owner') THEN

guard_ar2_budget_bucket_update().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_ar2_budget_bucket_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN
          IF ROW(NEW.org_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.bucket_kind,NEW.account_id,
                 NEW.period_start,NEW.period_end,NEW.currency,NEW.limit_minor)
             IS DISTINCT FROM
             ROW(OLD.org_id,OLD.project_id,OLD.bucket_kind,OLD.account_id,
                 OLD.period_start,OLD.period_end,OLD.currency,OLD.limit_minor)
             OR NEW.version<>OLD.version+1 OR NEW.updated_at<OLD.updated_at
          THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'budget bucket authority drifted'; END IF;
          RETURN NEW;
        END $function$

guard_ar2_budget_reservation_update().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_ar2_budget_reservation_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN
          IF ROW(NEW.org_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.reservation_id,NEW.invocation_id,
                 NEW.operation_id,NEW.invocation_key,NEW.task_ref,NEW.policy_ref,
                 NEW.pricing_ref,NEW.approval_ref,NEW.currency,NEW.upper_bound_minor,
                 NEW.request_hash,NEW.created_at)
             IS DISTINCT FROM
             ROW(OLD.org_id,OLD.project_id,OLD.reservation_id,OLD.invocation_id,
                 OLD.operation_id,OLD.invocation_key,OLD.task_ref,OLD.policy_ref,
                 OLD.pricing_ref,OLD.approval_ref,OLD.currency,OLD.upper_bound_minor,
                 OLD.request_hash,OLD.created_at)
          THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'budget reservation identity is immutable'; END IF;
          IF NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 OR NEW.content_hash=OLD.content_hash
             OR NEW.updated_at<OLD.updated_at OR NOT (
               (OLD.state='held' AND NEW.state IN ('submitted','released')) OR
               (OLD.state='submitted' AND NEW.state IN ('settled','released','unknown','cost_pending')) OR
               (OLD.state='unknown' AND NEW.state IN ('settled','released','cost_pending')) OR
               (OLD.state='cost_pending' AND NEW.state='settled'))
          THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid budget reservation transition'; END IF;
          IF NOT (
            (NEW.state='submitted' AND NEW.provider_request_receipt_ref IS NOT NULL
              AND NEW.provider_receipt_ref IS NULL AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.usage_receipt_refs)=0
              AND NEW.actual_minor IS NULL AND NEW.reconciliation_evidence_ref IS NULL) OR
            (NEW.state='unknown' AND NEW.provider_request_receipt_ref IS NOT NULL
              AND NEW.provider_receipt_ref IS NULL AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.usage_receipt_refs)=0
              AND NEW.actual_minor IS NULL AND NEW.reconciliation_evidence_ref IS NULL) OR
            (NEW.state='cost_pending' AND NEW.provider_request_receipt_ref IS NOT NULL
              AND NEW.provider_receipt_ref IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.usage_receipt_refs)>0
              AND NEW.actual_minor IS NULL
              AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.usage_receipt_refs)=(SELECT count(DISTINCT x) FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.usage_receipt_refs) x)) OR
            (NEW.state='settled' AND NEW.provider_request_receipt_ref IS NOT NULL
              AND NEW.provider_receipt_ref IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.usage_receipt_refs)>0
              AND NEW.actual_minor IS NOT NULL) OR
            (NEW.state='released' AND NEW.provider_receipt_ref IS NULL
              AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.usage_receipt_refs)=0 AND NEW.actual_minor IS NULL
              AND ((NEW.provider_request_receipt_ref IS NULL AND NEW.reconciliation_evidence_ref IS NULL)
                OR (NEW.provider_request_receipt_ref IS NOT NULL
                  AND NEW.reconciliation_evidence_ref IS NOT NULL))))
          THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'budget reservation state shape drifted'; END IF;
          IF OLD.state='cost_pending' AND ROW(NEW.provider_request_receipt_ref,NEW.provider_receipt_ref,NEW.usage_receipt_refs)
             IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.provider_request_receipt_ref,OLD.provider_receipt_ref,OLD.usage_receipt_refs)
          THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'completed execution evidence is immutable'; END IF;
          RETURN NEW;
        END $function$

guard_ar2_capability_invocation_update().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_ar2_capability_invocation_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN
          IF ROW(NEW.org_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.invocation_id,NEW.operation_id,
                 NEW.invocation_key,NEW.request_hash,NEW.task_ref,NEW.policy_ref,NEW.approval_ref,
                 NEW.pricing_ref,NEW.currency,NEW.upper_bound_minor,NEW.created_at)
             IS DISTINCT FROM
             ROW(OLD.org_id,OLD.project_id,OLD.invocation_id,OLD.operation_id,
                 OLD.invocation_key,OLD.request_hash,OLD.task_ref,OLD.policy_ref,OLD.approval_ref,
                 OLD.pricing_ref,OLD.currency,OLD.upper_bound_minor,OLD.created_at)
          THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'capability invocation identity is immutable'; END IF;
          IF NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 OR NEW.content_hash=OLD.content_hash
             OR NEW.updated_at<OLD.updated_at OR NOT (
               (OLD.state='prepared' AND NEW.state IN ('submitted','failed')) OR
               (OLD.state='submitted' AND NEW.state IN ('completed','failed','unknown')) OR
               (OLD.state='unknown' AND NEW.state IN ('completed','failed')))
          THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid capability invocation transition'; END IF;
          RETURN NEW;
        END $function$
